requirements.requirement: Identify a poem and the poetry collection book that contains it; the poem's name and the book's name are the requested outputs.
The poem's title is a single word in a language other than English.
The poem's last line consists of exactly two words, and those two words are identical to the title of the book.
The book is the fourth book of poetry by its author.
The book won an award between 2010 and 2020, inclusive, from an independent literary press.
The nomination for that award came from another well-known author born in the mid-1900s with a PhD in folklore.
